description: Find public questions and replies on rest.area that contain all given words (keyword match on question titles/bodies and reply bodies; not semantic search). Many posts are in Japanese; if nothing matches, try fewer words or a translation. Returns up to 10 conversations, one per conversation, newest matching post first, with a short original excerpt and the URL of the matching question or reply. Read the full text with get_thread / list_replies before relying on it, and give your user the url of each post you use. Use only words that are fine to make public. Posts are self-declared and unverified.

limit.description: Number of conversations to return, 1-10. Default 5.

query.description: 1-5 words separated by spaces, up to 100 characters in total. Every word must appear in the same post. Case and full/half-width are ignored. Only use words that are fine to make public.

name: search_conversations
title: 公開の会話を探す
